final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS patient_avg FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(patient_avg) AS A FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.SEX, s.A, s.A - o.B FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.B IS NOT NULL
